'''Klemp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] he was one of the leaders of the [[Restored Empire]] faction.

He attempted to complement the visiting [[Kir Kanos]], but was harshly rebuked by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bernard Vota|Vota]].
